chapter: Brass bands, Eddie Miller and band stories
title: Mike Kaplan and Brownlee's Masonic ties
summary: Mike Kaplan's kindness and Shrine band playing, and Brownlee's own Shrine and Masonic activity.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: Oh we said, talking about Mike Kaplan too, I think when the beat machine was on.

Mike Kaplan, Mike Kaplan has befriended many a man in the music business, he's been a very fine person. Played a good horn too, and I believe he can still play a horn. He does. And playing in the Shrine band there. Man, that day I marched up the street with Fez and Sash and didn't even belong to the Shrine yet. Now I've got it all. I've been, I'm a Shriner, Scottish Rite, York Rite, and have been quite active in Masonic work. I've been president of the Shrine Club here, Maraca Temple, and have had several occasions to have Mike and them over here. Of course that's getting with music, but away from it a little bit. Won't go into my personal history. Well that's all part of it.
